_about: Prototype pages that use this design system. tools/link_tokens.py links them to the shared tokens and tools/drift_check.py checks them. Paths are inside ~/Documents/GitHub; patterns like *.dc.html pick up new exports automatically.

codebases._about: App codebases (React and similar). They load tokens.css and components.css from sharedTokensUrl / sharedComponentsUrl in their entry page, so link_tokens.py leaves them alone. drift_check.py checks each one as a unit: the entry page must load the shared files, and all source files together must stick to tokens and the scales.

notUsingThisSystem.Implementation Tool/Implementation Tool: Built in the existing Client Implementation tool's style (Blazor, Telerik, Bootstrap 5.1) to match the live product. Intentionally not on these tokens.
